messages:
Ravi: kicking off Orpheus customer finetune onboarding — customer reported embedding drift after our int4 quant. Pushed a quick-eval pack 'orpheus-embed-smoke-v1'. Need a compatibility sweep: tokenizer hashes, embed dim, and adapter merge behavior.
Eva: grabbing pack now. running small sample (500 queries) with default int4 profile.
CI-bot: rwd eval started: quickpack=orpheus-embed-smoke-v1, quant=int4, samples=500, model=redwood/orn-13b-finetune-v3
Morgan: results (first pass): cos_sim mean 0.82 vs baseline 0.91 on float16. recall@10 dropped 0.78 -> 0.62. latency roughly unchanged. Notable regression.
Ravi: ugh that's pretty big. Tokenizer mismatch? OOVs?
Eva: checked tokenizer hashes — sha256:3f7a9e... identical. No OOV spike. But per-dim variance of embeddings jumps after quant.
Morgan: quant config used: --quant-config int4-qs8 (symmetric, per-channel). I can rerun with per-tensor scaling.
Samir: thought: Orpheus fine-tune uses a projection adapter (1024 -> 768 -> 1024). If LoRA/adapter weights are merged before quant, projection scaling could amplify quant error. Are adapters fused in the quant step?
Ravi: current pipeline merges LoRA/adapters into base weights pre-quant. For projection adapters we should test: (A) fuse then quantize vs (B) quantize base and keep adapter as fp16.
Eva: doing quick experiment: keep adapters fp16, quantize base only. Rerunning.
CI-bot: rwd eval started: quickpack=orpheus-embed-smoke-v1, quant=int4, keep_adapters_fp16=true
Morgan: new numbers: cos_sim mean 0.89, recall@10 0.74. Much improved, still a small gap but closer.
Ravi: good. Can we add a fallback policy in the model catalog that pins Orpheus to adapter_fp16 by default for customers sensitive to embed quality? Note cost impact.
Samir: cost delta measured ~+12% on our bench when keeping adapter fp16. Latency unchanged.
Eva: I'll add a canary model entry: orpheus-v3-quant-fallback with annotation 'adapter_fp16' and a rollout policy to prefer it for the customer's org id.
Morgan: also generated embedding variance numbers — snippet below:

``
baseline_mean_var: 0.024
int4_fused_mean_var: 0.11
int4_keep_adapters_fp16_mean_var: 0.028
``

Ravi: perfect. Next steps: (1) PR to add catalog entry + rollout policy, (2) update quantization playbook to recommend keeping adapters fp16 when projection dims differ, (3) send CS note with suggested config and perf delta.
Eva: opening PR now and tagging @Morgan for review. ETA EOD.
Morgan: will review and merge after CI passes. If CS wants lower-cost option we can explore per-channel asymmetric quant with clipping or softer quantization for projection layers.
Ravi: :thumbsup: solid plan — thanks team.
